Well, John, I want to thank you for having me on today. As you know, I've been working to build the Smithsonian Women's History Museum on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., so we can pay tribute to the women who have contributed so much in our nation's history from Susan B. And the black angels from my district in Staten Island, they were nurses who helped find the cure of tuberculosis. This museum, I think, is really an amazing thing. I was very proud this week because President Trump, at his Women's History Month celebration, supported my legislation, supports building the museum on the National Mall. As you know, he issued his executive order to protect women in sports. to make sure that men could not compete against girls, because we've seen young women, young girls get hurt, his support for IVF in trying to expand access to it, making our cities and our streets safe.
